tasks.label: Kill Flask and Dart Processes
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && (pkill -9 -f 'dart.*app\.dart' 2>/dev/null || true) && (pkill -9 -f 'python.*mixta_flask.*main\.py' 2>/dev/null || true) && (pkill -9 -f 'python.*app\.debug' 2>/dev/null || true) && for port in 5002 8080; do pids=$(lsof -ti :$port 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "🔪 Killing processes on port $port: $pids"; echo $pids | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 0.5; fi; done; sleep 2; remaining=$(lsof -ti :5002 :8080 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$remaining" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠️ Warning: Some processes may still be running"; else echo "✅ Ports 5002 and 8080 are now free"; fi
